QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_26

question.text: If an investor in a Cat III AIF remains dissatisfied with the Manager's ATR (Action Taken Report) on a grievance, the FIRST review mechanism is:

answer.text: The Designated Body for AIFs, which initiates first review, seeks clarification, and uploads revised ATR on SCORES within 10 days; investor may request this within 15 calendar days of receiving the original ATR.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 11.3.7: investor can request review within 15 calendar days of original ATR. Designated Body for AIFs conducts first review, uploads revised ATR on SCORES within 10 days. SEBI may intervene for a second review if investor remains unsatisfied. The Trap: Supreme Court, Singapore arbitration and distributor routes all bypass SEBI's prescribed SCORES/ODR ladder. Cross-Exam Context: Same escalation ladder in XIX-C/D. Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) is parallel path; investors can opt for ODR/civil remedies at any point. Manager's Pro-Tip: On investor onboarding, auto-email the SCORES link + ODR portal link so the investor has documented knowledge of escalation options — reduces the chance of a direct-to-SEBI complaint skipping your internal grievance cell.
